Sub-project rationale.

A 2006 flood hazard assessment for the entire country was done within the Grenada

National Hazard Mitigation Plan The assessment highlighted that flooding occurs along the

St. John's River on the floodplain, with most vulnerable areas in the vicinity of two sharp

bends and around the stadium by the Humpback Bridge, both of which flood even for a

frequent 2-year rainfall return period. The assessment found that danger posed by flooding
